name: shodh-launch-video
description: Shodh launch video (Remotion). Captions only; music generated in code.

scripts.studio: npm run music && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts ShodhLaunch out/shodh-launch.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:vertical: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts ShodhLaunchVertical out/shodh-launch-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
